# `code.rev.resolve`

Resolve a revision to a commit

Branches and tags resolve through the hosted ref listing; change ids, abbrev prefixes, and full oids resolve through the revset. Ambiguous names fail, never guess.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/revs/{rev}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code rev resolve`
- MCP: `code_rev_resolve`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `rev` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
